lines.text: Right. The honest version. That cache funds the next ten expeditions. Medicine. Materials. Gate research.
Leave it for my recovery team and your Terrarium will be very, very well supplied.
Or you brace the foundation. Aruun's way. The Span stays up. The Dominion gets nothing — and remembers.
It isn't my choice, Handler. Burden Architecture: build so that if one part fails, the rest survives.
With that Thoughtstone, this foundation holds for a very long time.
I'm not looking at this one. Some choices should be made without me touching them.

choice.text: Brace the foundation. The Span stays.
Hand the cache to the Dominion contract.
